candidate.answerReason: Each square meter equals 100 square decimeters, so 2 square meters equals 200 square decimeters.

methods.label: Apply the area conversion factor
methods.explanation: 1 square meter = 100 square decimeters. Thus, 2 square meters is \(2\times100=200\) square decimeters.
methods.levelReason: Adjacent area-unit conversion and multiplication involving whole hundreds are within Grade 3.
